title: What Is Randomness? Can Anything Truly Be Random?
question: Is there such a thing as genuine randomness in the universe, or is everything we call 'random' just complexity we haven't traced back to its causes yet?
summary: From dice to quantum decay to the pseudo-random numbers inside your phone, 'random' turns out to be a surprisingly slippery word, and physics itself splits into two camps about whether true randomness exists at all.
